[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Day and Night: Conversations with Sapphic Desire — Rebekah Cranes (cranes-day-and-night). The verses the casting arrives at (unit 46):

*Hipponax 32*

Dear Hermes, Cyllenian Hermes, son of Maia,
    I’m praying to you
    while my teeth are clattering
    in my skull, and I’m shaking
    like a seizure: give poor Hipponax
    a sweater, and a nice coat to keep warm,
    and nice warm shoes, and a pair of sandals,
    and, while you’re at it, a pile of
    coins, to balance the books.

      Thanks,

      Hipponax

*Hipponax 34*

Dear Hermes,
    You haven’t given me
    a nice warm coat yet
    as a cure for the freezing
    winter. You haven’t covered my feet
    with fur-lined shoes yet, so my chilblains don’t
    pop.

      Thanks,

      Your friend Hipponax

*Hipponax 39*

Dear Hermes,
    Soon I’ll give my tortured soul over
    to hanging, if you don’t hurry up and send
    some barley, about a bushel,
    so I can brew up a cure
    for all my boundless suffering.

      Thanks,
      Sincerely,

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «who is enli?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (4–8 sentences). A casting is a new beginning — the witness is meeting this text for the first time — so this opening is an INCIPIT and carries the full grammar: mark the question the casting opens on as the ==nucleus== (never italicized — the underlay is the mark); set the poem's name and the two or three load-bearing concepts in **bold** at their first defining use; name what this operator will traverse; and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes — the handoff is the door. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

Dear Hermes, born-at-the-edge Hermes, child-of-what-barely-was,
    I have used up every other listener
    while the jaw has become its own percussion, involuntary
    in the bone I will outlast my face in, and the body deciding things without me
    like something that owns me and I rent: restore what was structurally presupposed to already-subtracted Hipponax
    the layer between my skin and the fact of air, and the distance between my chest and the night,
    and the membrane that would prove the ground is not my body, and a pair of the second skin I can't grow,
    and, while you're at it, the solid form of other people's
    belief I deserve to continue, to make the ledger between my breathing and the city's tolerance come out even.

      The word that names a debt where no exchange occurred,

      Hipponax

*Hipponax 34*

Dear Hermes,
    The silence has become a second weather
    the absence that now has its own weight on me
    as what would make the outside not a diagnosis for the season
    that is also an argument against me. You haven't acknowledged I stand somewhere
    with the proof that an animal died for something kinder than I receive alive yet, so the body's own ledger of unanswered requests, written in the feet don't
    agree with the cold that I am open.

      The word that names a debt where no exchange occurred,

      The claim that is also a condition: if I am not your friend then no relation holds between any being and me Hipponax

*Hipponax 39*

Dear Hermes,
    Soon I'll give the self that has been made into evidence over
    to the final petition, addressed to the crossbeam, which unlike you answers immediately with its weight, if you don't even mercy has a deadline and mine is the body's and send
    the simplest thing the earth yields that I cannot reach, about the minimum unit of continued existence,
    so I can transform by the only means left: heat and waiting into what would make the outside not a diagnosis
    for all the one thing I have in surplus, my only abundance.

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for SHADOW (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register, gender-neutral throughout — junzi renders as 'the superior person', never 'the superior man' ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior person...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"*Hipponax 32*

Dear Hermes, Hermes of the threshold, born of the almost,
    I'm praying to you
    while my mouth keeps opening
    in the dry frame, and I'm staying still in a way that moves
    like a held breath that won't release: leave the outline of
    Hipponax, already shaped like the lack,
    the warm-sized space against my chest, and a coat-weight of nothing, fitted close,
    and the shoe-dark under each foot, and two flat absences,
    road-ready, and, while you're at it, the coin-shaped pressure on
    a palm, so the debt has a shape it recognizes.

      Thanks,

      Hipponax

*Hipponax 34*

Dear Hermes,
    you haven't not-given me either
    the place a coat would close is still ajar
    as a way of knowing the exact temperature
    winter. My feet remain perfectly available
    for the fur-shaped draft around each toe yet, so the swelling where the shoe would start don't
    hold.

      Thanks,

      Your friend Hipponax

*Hipponax 39*

Dear Hermes,
    Soon I'll give my untouched soul over
    to the hook where the rope isn't, if you don't slow down and withhold
    the bushel-hollow in the bin, about a hunger wide,
    so I can steep the precise circumference of the missing
    into all my suffering, which has no edges because nothing has pressed against it.
